name: Valkyr's Grip exempts a Sun Cleric from the Titan's Grip damage penalty (#9006)
contract: Player::CanTitanGrip() and the equip-swap path already treat HasBurningCommander() and HasValkyrGrip() as
equivalent, parallel conditions granting dual two-handed weapon use. Player::UpdateTitansGrip() only checked
HasBurningCommander() before applying the native -10% Titan's Grip damage-reduction aura (49152), so a Sun
Cleric with Valkyr's Grip (707072) who equips two two-handed weapons kept the stock Warrior/Hero penalty this
ability was never meant to carry. Adding HasValkyrGrip() to that same check removes the aura for a Sun
Cleric while a stock Warrior with native Titan's Grip (46917) still gets it, exactly as before.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Titan's Grip penalty with only one two-hander equipped
Second two-hander in the off hand
Off-hand two-hander carries real weapon damage (the equip itself succeeded)
Valkyr's Grip exempts the Sun Cleric from the Titan's Grip damage penalty
Off-hand two-hander carries real weapon damage for the Warrior too
A stock Warrior's native Titan's Grip keeps its own damage penalty
